name: Clascoterone
description: Cortexolone 17α-propionate, a steroid that blocks the androgen receptor in skin where it is applied

note.text: Two Phase 3 hair-loss trials in about 1,465 men are completed; no results are posted or published.

bullets: **Androgen receptor inhibitor,** per the label; acne mechanism unknown
**Does not lower** testosterone or DHT; blocks their action where applied
**In lab-grown scalp cells,** it blocked androgen-driven gene activity
**In people,** the effect on hair is not established
Hair: 2 Phase 3 trials, results not posted

practical.routes: On the skin (1% cream); 5% scalp solution in trials
practical.pharmacokinetics: Steady state by day 5; possible metabolite cortexolone
practical.monitored: HPA axis suppression, potassium, skin reactions

regulatory.text: Approved for acne, age 12+ (2020); not hair loss

references: Hebert et al., JAMA Dermatol, two Phase 3 acne trials, Jun 2020
ClinicalTrials.gov, SCALP1 (NCT05910450) and SCALP2 (NCT05914805), accessed Nov 2026
